notes: DiscoFlate v3.86.0 — 🎭 Scenes tab, properly laid out. The canvas, its controls and the properties panel are one column now, so the two lists beside them run the FULL height of the section, equal to each other, with their right edge on the same gutter the canvas has on the left. ↩ Ctrl+Z undoes canvas changes — move, resize, rotate, add, delete, reorder, any property — 60 deep, and a snapshot taken in one scene can never be applied to another. Clicking an overlay in the list no longer yanks the page down to the properties panel; it sits under the canvas now, already in view. Export/Import Scene move out of the top row into the controls strip under the canvas.
